name: Shinohara Hiyo
source:
Hiyo is a short-haired brunette girl with blue eyes. She likes dancing and moves around a lot during the storyline. She is Kazuki's kouhai. She is a very bright and energetic girl, and calls Kazuki "Oniichan"  She has a super crush on Kazuki, and gets very "watchful" when any girls are around Kazuki. Her real identity is Prototype #1 of a Communication-purpose-oid created by professor Shinohara. While she hides this fact, the people around her have more or less sensed it but does not reveal it.

[Based on [url=https://gamicus.fandom.com/wiki/SchoolMate]Codex Gamicus[/url]]
